target.title: feat(android): polish skill management
target.body:
Related: #101864

## What Problem This Solves

Android's new Skills settings exposed the right capabilities, but the screen was long, dense, and difficult to scan. Installed skill readiness and ClawHub discovery competed in one scrolling surface, while Gateway risk output was hard to read.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reorganizes Skills into focused Installed and Browse modes, adds a compact readiness overview and filters, and presents Gateway security outcomes as readable status cards. Explicit risk acknowledgement stays fail-closed until the user expands and reviews the Gateway warning.

## User Impact

Android users can find, filter, enable, disable, review, and install skills with less scrolling and clearer security feedback. ClawHub clean, review-required, and blocked states remain Gateway-enforced.

## Evidence

- Real API 35 emulator against a temporary production Gateway and deterministic ClawHub-compatible fixture: verified Installed/Browse navigation, readiness filters, clean install and refresh, review-required warning, and zero-download-before-ack behavior.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kxbn1rrbf4c8e1vcax6dzp87` ([warmup run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29201563697)).
- `corepack pnpm android:i18n:check`
- `corepack pnpm android:lint`
- `corepack pnpm android:test`
- `corepack pnpm android:test:third-party`
- Fresh autoreview: clean after fixing its consent-gating finding.
